contract.cost: 0: packaged XAU bars have no bid/ask/spread fields; no fee is invented
contract.displacement_timing: exactly S+1; S+2 and S+3 are rejected, not silently accepted
contract.entry: close of the completed displacement candle
contract.fvg: wick-to-wick low(D) > high(S-1) for long / high(D) < low(S-1) for short
contract.horizon: three following completed 15m bars; 1m OHLC orders exits, stop-first on same-minute ambiguity
contract.post_candle: small/hammer labels are descriptive only and cannot make a signal eligible
contract.stop: one source tick (0.001 XAU price unit) beyond sweep extreme
contract.sweep: LONG: low < prior confirmed swing low and close > it; SHORT: high > prior confirmed swing high and close < it
contract.swing_confirmation: strict three-candle swing; pivot becomes available on the next completed candle
contract.target: nearest prior confirmed opposite swing before the swept swing: HIGH before swept LOW for long, LOW before swept HIGH for short
